name: Extra Drake Power
body:
Your power and that of your charge flows through you more easily than most.

Prerequisite(s): Drake, must have a charge.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional drake power.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
